sentences.en: I agree with you that the actor is very talented.
sentences.zh: 我同意你那个演员很有才能。

sentences.en: The least talented player will be kicked off the team.
sentences.zh: 最没有才能的队员将会被开除出队。

sentences.en: If only I were such a beautiful and talented person.
sentences.zh: 要是我也能成为那样美丽又有才华的人就好了。

senses.zh: 有才能的，有才干的,能干的
